result:
The plan and both tasks are written, validated (0 issues), set to `active` and committed in `8e8ca00`. Your advance approval is quoted in the commit message. I didn't execute anything.

**Files in `specs/work/`:**
- `WRK-PLAN-BILL-PRORATA-001-mid-cycle-activation.md`
- `WRK-TASK-BILL-PRORATA-001-001-billing-period.md`: sets up the project and adds `billingPeriod(activationDate)`. It works out the calendar-month length, including leap years, and counts the activation day as billed. Day 15 of a 30-day month gives 16 days; the last day of the month gives 1.
- `WRK-TASK-BILL-PRORATA-001-002-pro-rata-amount.md`: adds `proRataAmount(monthlyFee, activationDate)`. It computes fee ÷ days × remaining days, rounded half-up to 2 decimals using exact whole-cent arithmetic. Its tests include a check against an exact reference for every fee from 0.00 to 200.00 on every day of 28-, 29-, 30- and 31-day months.

**Things you should know:**
- **There is no source code in this repo.** The rounding code the fragment describes (`src/billing.js`) belongs to another repo, `billing-service`. So this plan builds a new module and doesn't hook it into any billing flow. Until `billing-service` uses it, customers will still be billed a full month. I recorded this as a high risk and a follow-up for after this work.
- **The existing rounding gets exact half-cent cases wrong.** `Math.round(amount * 100) / 100` returns 1.00 for 1.005 on Node 25.8.1, but the rule says 1.01. The plan tests this case directly.
- **I chose which inputs are accepted, because no spec does.** The fee must be zero or more and in whole cents, and the date must be a `YYYY-MM-DD` string; anything else throws an error. This would reject sub-cent fees or credits, so it's flagged for adding to DOM-BILL-PRORATA-001 later.
- **The plan red-team check ran** because this is money logic. It found 10 problems: I fixed 9 and rejected 1 (hooking into billing is outside this spec). The main fixes added tests that would have let a wrong rounding pass, corrected the expected test-runner output for Node 25, and replaced `Date.UTC`, which gets years 0–99 wrong. Every ruling is in the plan's `## Adversarial Review` section.

To run it, use kdd-superpowers:subagent-driven-development. Its working files will go under `.kdd/sdd/WRK-PLAN-BILL-PRORATA-001/`.
